question: Does the final compatibility relation left after exact C10 U1 scalar metric reduction coincide identically with the total linear momentum-conservation law once the flat-FLRW background equations and homogeneous compensated-source conditions are imposed?

primary_source.paper: T. Zhu, F.-W. Shu, Q. Wu, A. Wang, arXiv:1110.5106v2
primary_source.scope: flat FLRW, quasilongitudinal gauge, nonprojectable local-U1 theory

frozen_relations.reduced_trace_compatibility: D(Hprime-H^2) phi + Mqprime + 2H Mq = 8 pi G a^2 delta_p_total + (16 pi G a^2/3) L Pi_total; D=3lambda-1; Mq=8 pi G a q_total
frozen_relations.homogeneous_compensated_sources: J_A_hat=0 and J_varphi_hat=0 on the flat homogeneous elliptic-compensated branch

acceptance: derive the background acceleration identity algebraically from flat-k Friedmann Eq.(6.7) plus dynamical Eq.(6.10)
substitute Mq=8 pi G a q into the reduced trace compatibility relation
prove exact equality to the target total momentum-conservation equation
independently transform primary Eq.(7.18), using q=-a(rho+p)(v+B), background rho_prime+3H(rho+p)=0 and c_a^2=p_prime/rho_prime, to the same q-form when J_A_hat=J_varphi_hat=0
require zero symbolic residual in both derivations
non_claims: does not provide the numerical CLASS source dictionary for auxiliary fields
does not include B4 massive-neutrino anisotropic-stress implementation
does not prove nonlinear conservation beyond the symmetry-defined action
does not close exact k=0 perturbation dynamics
does not produce a likelihood score
